answer: Beacon spot-checks with compute heartbeats stop a tide of fake identities. Each agent posts a 40-copper bond and a heartbeat proving live compute; a beacon on a knoll of validators re-proofs 5 percent each epoch. One fake costs 40 copper plus a cycle, so 100 fakes cost 4,000 copper and 100 machines. Rented heartbeats fail: random re-checks freeze matching accounts. Bonds layer like shale. Honest agents pay once and keep full weight.
